# Agents' states from their screens (agent-screen-status): a "codex"
# (tests/fixtures/fake-codex.c, built into @DIR@ by tests/run.sh) shows a
# turn's timer, then its prompt at rest: working, then done. What the
# screen says reaches liberttyd too: `+events --for working` hears it.
type:libertty +events --for working --once --timeout 20 > @DIR@/events.txt 2>&1 & sleep 0.5; @DIR@/codex
key:enter
wait:2.5
expect-status:tab=working
expect-shell:cat @DIR@/events.txt ==> "source":"screen"
expect-shell:cat @DIR@/events.txt ==> "state":"working"
wait:3.5
expect-status:tab=done
# A redraw of the same screen changes nothing.
size:700x420
wait:1.5
expect-status:tab=done
